description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Amended Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2213/35 dated 03rd February 2021, (issued under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017)
reasoning: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017. It specifically amends existing foreign exchange regulations regarding capital transactions by persons resident outside Sri Lanka. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, legal amendments, and statutory instruments related to financial regulations. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it for Types 1-3.
